attempts.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational, photographic exercise keyposes for human review. Create a TWO-PANEL contact sheet, panels STACKED VERTICALLY, both wide landscape frames, separated by a thin cream gutter. Image reference is ONLY for the woman's identity, green shirt/plum leggings and warm printed-photo style. Do NOT retain the reference camera angle or bar orientation.
NEW CAMERA: exact 90-degree SIDE PROFILE of a woman performing a straight-leg inverted row on a PAIR of freestanding parallel dip bars. Camera is perpendicular to her sagittal plane, at torso height, level, no perspective along the body. Her feet point to image LEFT; head toward RIGHT. Only her near-side facial profile, near shoulder, elbow and wrist are fully visible. Far arm/hand/bar naturally overlap and may be hidden. Never move the far limb into view artificially.
Equipment: two parallel rigid green inverted-U stands running LENGTHWISE beside her body, their long horizontal handrails parallel to her head-to-feet axis. Side view shows the nearer U as ONE LONG HORIZONTAL rail on two vertical legs with stable feet, farther stand naturally behind it. Woman is BETWEEN the stands, near arm between her torso and the near rail. Fully closed hand wraps the top rail from inside; no crossing over the upright, no rail through arm. Rail height and length allow her body to hang underneath with shoulders and hips above floor. Both heels rest on mat. Entire equipment and body in frame with8% margins.
TOP PANEL: start hanging position, near elbow extended, hand vertically above shoulder, straight body line head-shoulder-hip-knee-heel, hips off floor. Far arm naturally occluded.
BOTTOM PANEL: completed row, SAME exact camera/mat/bar/hand-grip/heel locations. Near elbow bends and moves down alongside ribs, chest rises toward handrail height, body stays straight rotating about fixed heels. Neutral head follows torso, no backward neck crane. Same actual limb lengths and body size. NO extra arm in foreground, no second visible arm if hidden from profile.
Both panels must have matching fixed hand and heel contacts and apparatus dimensions. Clean warm cream#F4EEE4 wall, wood floor, inkgreen#012F2B mat/stands/top, plum#59114D leggings. Quiet orange#E98A15 accent at far edge. Subtle 1990s printed photograph grain, natural ordinary athletic woman, tied hair, flat shoes. No text, numbers, logos, arrows or overlays. Priority: true side view, understandable near arm, physical hardware consistency.
attempts.finding: Profile readable, but starting elbow not fully extended and torso/leg line inconsistent.

attempts.prompt: Edit this two-panel profile exercise image with ONE targeted correction. In TOP PANEL ONLY, straighten the woman's body into one continuous straight line from shoulder through hip, knee and ankle. Raise the sagging pelvis slightly and remove the slight knee bend, keeping both heels anchored in exactly the same spots, near hand still at same rail grip, arm still extended, shoulders at same height. Do not arch the back. Preserve the entire bottom panel unchanged. Preserve camera, side view, face, clothing, all rail dimensions, both equipment feet and all background pixels/layout. No extra visible far arm. Keep natural subtle retro photographic texture. Return same two-panel image with top hanging posture straighter. Do not change the completed row in bottom panel.
attempts.finding: Pelvis edit raised shoulders too; no longer a low hanging position, near elbow bent.

attempts.prompt: Edit ONLY the TOP panel of this side-profile two-panel image. Bottom panel untouched. TOP must show a genuinely LOWER hanging position with a STRAIGHT near arm: hand stays on rail; shoulder is lower and a little to the right of the hand; elbow lies exactly on the straight line from wrist to shoulder, no elbow bend. Body long and straight with hips clear of mat and knees straight, heels fixed to the same mat spots. Do not lift shoulders to straighten the body: LOWER them instead, lengthening the hanging arm naturally without stretching limb lengths. Preserve all anatomy proportions. This is the beginning of a row, not an intermediate contraction. Keep bottom contracted position, fixed camera, fixed handgrip and equipment. Same profile and clean retro photo. No extra limbs or labels.
attempts.finding: Near arm straighter but pelvis appears to rest on mat; rejected.

attempts.prompt:
Create two vertically stacked wide photographic panels showing low and high positions of an inverted row on a pair of tall parallel dip bars, STRICT SIDE VIEW, camera perpendicular to body. Woman wearing dark green T-shirt and plum leggings, cream room and wood floor, green mat, subtle warm1990s printed photo grain. Feet at left, head at right. Rail is HIGH ENOUGH to leave a generous visible gap under the hips even with arms fully straight. Dip stands about100cm tall, woman about165cm tall. Two parallel U-shaped stands overlap naturally in this exact side view. Visible near hand grips near rail from inside, other arm hidden behind, don't invent extra limbs. Hands fixed on handles, heels fixed on mat, hardware fixed between panels.
TOP low position: near elbow completely straight, wrist elbow shoulder form a straight diagonal line. Her entire torso, hips, knees and ankles make one straight diagonal plank from supported heels to suspended shoulders. Knees completely straight. Her pelvis is well ABOVE mat, at least20cm gap underneath it, torso does not rest on floor. Neck aligned with trunk. No sagging hips.
BOTTOM high position: near elbow bent, chest pulled toward handrail, straight body rotated upwards about fixed heels. Same limb proportions. Hand grip and heel contacts remain at exactly matching positions within each panel. Top of head always within rail upright opening, no metal cutting through body. Entire woman and stands and support feet visible. NO reference to a situp or hipbridge. Exact side profile. No text or numbers.
attempts.finding: Independent regeneration: low elbow still bent, changed foot support and body proportions. Rejected.
